catalysts.headline: IonQ press release confirms Q3 2026 earnings date of November 5, 2026, conference call 4:30pm ET

Closed the previously announced $2.0 billion equity offering: 20.5 million common shares plus 29.5 million pre-funded warrants, each priced at $40.00/unit (~15% premium to the Oct 13, 2026 close of $34.78); includes 100 million seven-year Series C warrants exercisable at $69.46/share; buyer an entity managed by Heights Capital Management; J.P. Morgan sole underwriter
catalysts.impact: Resolves whether the Oct 14 priced offering actually closed -- it did, on Oct 16

catalysts.headline: IonQ shares rose 9.33% to $34.35 on volume more than 100% above average, rebounding from the prior day's equity-offering-related drop
catalysts.impact: +9.33%; still about 53.5% below the 52-week high of $73.87

catalysts.headline: IonQ priced a $2.0 billion common stock offering
catalysts.impact: Shares fell about 5.2% on the pricing news

catalysts.headline: IonQ disclosed plans to deploy its 256-qubit Superion 256 system at NVIDIA's Accelerated Quantum Research Center (NVAQC), directly connected to NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 infrastructure via NVIDIA NVQLink, with workload management through NVIDIA's open CUDA-Q platform; installation timeline given as 2027, with no performance results yet available for this configuration

IonQ and Synopsys reported a quantum-classical hybrid workflow that cut computer-aided-engineering simulation runtimes by 5.9%-14.6% on digital models (automobile, industrial drill component, fluid impeller, jet-engine assembly), simulated at up to 150 qubits with physical execution validated on IonQ's 36-qubit Forte system; one of nine IonQ papers accepted at IEEE Quantum Week 2026 (Toronto, Sept 13-18)

IonQ-Synopsys hybrid quantum-classical workflow cut engineering-simulation runtimes 5.9%-14.6% (won IEEE Quantum Week 2026 Best Paper); IonQ also raised FY26 revenue guidance to $260M-$270M and launched its Superion 256 platform
catalysts.impact: stock up about 9.5%; gains reportedly tempered into the close by a same-day CEO share-sale disclosure

catalysts.headline: Record Q2 2026 results: revenue $80.1M (+287% YoY), beating estimates ($49.7M-$66.5M range); raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $280M-$290M (excludes SkyWater acquisition contribution); adjusted EBITDA loss $120.3M; GAAP net loss $1.87B (mostly non-cash warrant-liability revaluation)
catalysts.impact: Shares rose on the beat/guidance raise

catalysts.headline: Q2 2026 results: revenue $80.05M (+287% YoY vs $20.69M), above the high end of prior guidance; raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $290M; GAAP net loss of $1.87B driven primarily by a $1.65B non-cash warrant-liability revaluation; free cash flow roughly -$114M
IonQ closed its acquisition of SkyWater Technology (semiconductor foundry), adding chip-manufacturing capability; cash+investments fell from ~$3.0B to a pro forma ~$2.0B as a result
